title: KKT‑guided strict finalize + 60s micro‑tail (1140s+60s; dual+slack ordering)
abstract: Runs deterministic KKT‑guided strict‑finalize for 1140s (30s segments, dK=12), then a 60s strict micro‑tail polish (k_pairs=232, α0=6e−5). Pairs ranked by blended dual magnitude and slack tightness; exact LP objective throughout.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np, sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
import active_quench as AQ
from active_quench_kkt_guided import strict_finalize_kkt_guided

def construct_packing():
    # Main guided finalize
    C, r, S = strict_finalize_kkt_guided(
        total_sec=1140.0,
        seed=20251216,
        alpha0=1.1e-4,
        backtrack=0.5,
        alpha_min=1e-6,
        k_pairs_init=176,
        dK=12,
        segment_sec=30.0,
        w_dual=1.0,
        w_slack=1.0,
        boundary_push=0.68
    )
    # 60s strict micro‑tail
    C, r, S = AQ.active_pair_quench(
        C, budget_sec=60.0, seed=20251216+1,
        k_pairs=232, alpha0=6e-5, backtrack=0.5, alpha_min=1e-6, boundary_push=0.70
    )
    # Validity checks
    assert C.shape == (26,2) and r.shape == (26,)
    assert np.all(r > 0)
    x, y = C[:,0], C[:,1]
    b = np.minimum.reduce([x, 1-x, y, 1-y])
    assert np.all(r <= b + 1e-9)
    return C, r
